final_assessment: Captured the session's diagnosis at the program layer rather than inside the change that produced it, which is R-crc-6 operating on its own first day. rc02's four proposal passes ran 0C/9W/4S then 3C/7W/1S then 3C/8W/2S then 4C/9W/4S with ZERO repeat findings across the whole shared axis, so the premise's churn mechanism does not describe them: each walk answered findings by inventing mechanism, and each pass correctly found defects in mechanism nobody had reviewed. Nine of the ten CRITICALs were in mechanism that did not exist when the exploration closed. Two rulings recorded — R-crc-6 (the walk authors nothing; repair, descope, redesign, with redesign routing back to explore) and R-crc-7 (explore produces mechanism to the fidelity the artifact demands, executes the procedure once before specifying it, and specifies procedures as decision tables). One new stage, rc13-explore-mechanism, carries the fix at its root: the explore surface has no mechanism section, grades maturity by decision count, and never asks the author to falsify — all three verified against the shipped surface. Four charters gained measured evidence rather than new scope (rc03 blind review and execute-don't-read, rc04 the churn-versus-authoring diagnostic, rc08 the three lanes, rc09 the generalized spike). Two directions declined and recorded with re-entry triggers: rewriting rc02's criterion as a table before applying it, and splitting rc02 again on the byte overage. rc01 ratified complete. Thirteen stages.
